name: Authentication + Tenant/Workspace Reality Path
commander_directive: FINISH THE REALITY PATH — P3 Auth → P4 Tenant Isolation → P8 Evidence → P9 External Outcome → P10 Real Human. No new primitives. Substrate frozen. Productionization only.
definition_of_done: A fresh authenticated user must be able to enter the LawyersHub workspace, operate inside the correct tenant/workspace boundary, create/continue the same Work, and leave durable evidence that survives process restart. ALL 8 gates have passing evidence.

G1 Auth works (P3).blocker: invokeAsync() not implemented - ALL API routes throw 'not fully implemented'
acceptance: Signup creates user + tenant + workspace + membership (4 entities)
Session cookie is set (httpOnly, lax)
Login validates password via scrypt + timingSafeEqual
Logout invalidates session
Session route returns authenticated:false after logout

G2 Tenant isolation works (P4).blocker: Same invokeAsync blocker; plus inputWorkspaceId no-fallback skips DB validation
acceptance: User A cannot create Work in Tenant B's workspace
Cross-tenant access attempt throws 403 or security error
Postgres FK: cases.tenant_id → tenants.id enforced
UNIQUE(user_id, workspace_id) on memberships prevents duplicate access grants
Postgres case.save() writes to cases table
Round-trip camelCase ↔ snake_case preserves all fields
work_id column non-null for all created cases
version-based optimistic concurrency works
docker compose down → up preserves persisted Work
Case data survives web container death
In-memory state is NOT used for production path
B4 F004-F007 PASS (from prior experiments)
LawyersHub UI is reachable
Work View shows state
Next-action recovery works

G6 Independent evidence (P8).blocker: Current run-p8-experiment.ts uses in-process calls, NOT HTTP against deployed stack
acceptance: P8 runner hits actual HTTP endpoints (signup → login → create case)
Process death simulated via docker compose restart
7 invariants verified: work_id + tenant_id + workspace_id + actor_id + status + priority + version
Evidence JSON is SHA-linkable and independently reproducible
Leave → Return flow works via HTTP
"You stopped here: Document Review" context restored
Same Work Identity (workId) constant across leave/return
"Next Action" is actionable and continues Work
3 real humans complete EOS FIRST LIGHT flow
Did they return? → YES
Did EOS correctly restore context? → YES
Did they actually continue the work? → YES
1 qualitative question: what's the most disruptive thing if EOS forgot your work?

tasks.title: Fix invokeAsync() delegation to invoke()
tasks.description: invokeAsync throws 'not fully implemented' for all commands. All API routes use invokeAsync(). Must delegate to this.invoke() with correct return type handling.

tasks.title: Expand publicCommands set to match actual command names
tasks.description: Add identity.loginFlow, identity.authenticateUser, identity.createTenantWithSlugResolution, identity.getWorkspacesByTenant, identity.getWorkspaceById, identity.getSessionById to public commands. Also identity.logout if it exists.

tasks.title: Fix inputWorkspaceId fallback for session validation guard
tasks.description: Line 391: inputWorkspaceId defaults to undefined if not in request. Line 398 requires BOTH inputTenantId && inputWorkspaceId to be truthy for DB-backed session validation. If workspaceId is not in input (common pattern), ALL tenant/workspace isolation checks are SKIPPED. Fix: fallback inputWorkspaceId to session.workspaceId before the conditional. Or remove inputWorkspaceId from required guard.

tasks.title: Run base-repository-smoke.test.ts
tasks.description: Confirm camelCase ↔ snake_case round-trip was properly fixed. This validates the bugfix mentioned in lh-prod-003-evidence.yaml.

tasks.title: Start staging Docker stack (postgres + web + caddy)
tasks.description: docker compose up -d, wait for healthchecks on all 3 services. Verify /api/health returns 200 via caddy.

tasks.title: Verify P3 Auth against LIVE stack (HTTP)
tasks.description: Sequence: signup → verify session → logout → verify no auth → login → verify session again. All via real HTTP calls to staging stack.

tasks.title: Verify P4 Tenant Isolation against LIVE stack (HTTP)
tasks.description: Create TenantA+UserA and TenantB+UserB. As UserA with UserA session: try to create case with tenantId=TenantB. MUST fail with security error. Then create with UserA's own tenantId: MUST succeed.

tasks.title: Create P8 Deployed-Path Runner script
tasks.description: Script that exercises P8 flow against LIVE HTTP endpoints, NOT in-process. Sequence: signup → login → create work → verify persistence → docker compose stop/up → login → verify work persisted → 7 invariants. Output evidence JSON.

tasks.title: Execute P8 deployed-path runner
tasks.description: Run the script, save evidence to .eos-state/evidence/P8-DEPLOYED-{timestamp}.json.

tasks.title: Create P9 Human-Resumption Proof script
tasks.description: EOS FIRST LIGHT flow via HTTP: signup lawyer → create matter → add document → work (update status to UNDER_REVIEW) → leave (logout + restart) → return → verify 'You stopped here: Document Review' → continue → verify WorkId still constant.

tasks.title: Update lh-prod-003-evidence.yaml with REAL runtime evidence
tasks.description: Replace all observed:false entries with actual observed values from running stack. Append audit trail entries with timestamps for every completed step.
